Name: John Deere Riding Mower Deluxe Cover 93647
Natural: EasyOn side handles make snugging down cover a snap. Dual reinforced air vents let air circulate and help prevent ballooning in wind. Wipe clean reinforced bottom around mower deck. Interior lining and integrated muffler heat shield. Heavy-duty fabric wont shrink or stretch and is coated for maximum water resistance and repellency. Handy storage pocket reverses into a storage case. EasyOn split back for fast fitting and easy access after installation. Fits John Deere X300 - X700 series lawn tractors.
